titulo: Jaguar’s first EV looks just like its divisive concept car
cuerpo: The Type 01, Jaguar's most important and divisive car in years, has arrived. The production follow-up to the polarising Type 00 concept, Jaguar says the electric, four-door grand tourer is its most powerful road car ever.
